title: IndiGo Flight Diverted to Surat Due to Child's Medical Emergency
summary: An IndiGo flight traveling from Ahmedabad to Navi Mumbai was diverted to Surat following a medical emergency involving a three-year-old child on board. The child became unconscious during the flight, prompting the diversion. Medical personnel were involved, and the child's life was reportedly saved.
summary_points: An IndiGo flight from Ahmedabad to Navi Mumbai diverted to Surat.
The diversion was due to a medical emergency involving a three-year-old child.
The child became unconscious during the flight.
The flight landed safely in Surat.
Doctors' intervention reportedly saved the child's life.

summary_points_hi: अहमदाबाद से नवी मुंबई जा रही इंडिगो की फ्लाइट को सूरत में डायवर्ट किया गया।
